summary_points.profile: Accomplished professional with extensive experience in global sales operations, currently serving as VP Global Sales Operations at Wesco. Proven track record in the industries of Wesco, Anixter, and GE, with a focus on driving sales growth and operational efficiency.
summary_points.expertise: Demonstrates strong leadership in sales operations, with a keen ability to optimize processes and enhance team performance. Skilled in strategic planning and execution, with a focus on achieving measurable business outcomes.
summary_points.education: Holds a Bachelor degree in Commerce with a specialization in Financial Accounting and Auditing, providing a solid foundation in financial principles and business acumen.
summary_points.aspirations: Aims to leverage extensive industry experience to further drive strategic initiatives in sales operations, targeting senior leadership roles that focus on global market expansion and operational excellence.

experience_highlights.title: VP Global Sales Operations
achievements: ● Spearheaded the integration of Wesco's product and services portfolio, enhancing Electrical and Electronic Solutions, Communications and Security Solutions, and Utility and Broadband Solutions.
● Collaborated with premier industry suppliers to deliver innovative solutions, meeting diverse customer needs across commercial and industrial sectors.
● Enhanced supply chain services and digital capabilities, supporting thousands of customers globally in various industries including government and telecommunications.
● Contributed to Wesco's position as a FORTUNE 500® company with over $22 billion in annual sales, driving business-to-business distribution and logistics services.
